reason: Hypothesis B proposes a specific, testable mechanism—reducing reactive elements and refining grain size to enhance short-range diffusion of Cr/Al—with a clear intervention, baseline, and falsification rule, and it is well-grounded in cited evidence showing Ti reduction and grain refinement improve oxidation resistance. Hypothesis A relies on a vague 'synergistic segregation' mechanism without specifying how entropy overcomes kinetics, lacks supporting evidence, and is less precise in its predicted outcome and falsification.
